description: This PHP class 'DestroyReportToPurgeStrategy' extends 'PurgeStrategy' and implements a method to purge records related to an employee number, specifically targeting subordinate and supervisor entries in the database.

classes.name: DestroyReportToPurgeStrategy
classes.description: A class responsible for deleting related employee report data based on employee number, within a purge process strategy.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Deletes all report entities associated with a specific employee number, including subordinate and supervisor relationships.
